name: Araburu Oppai-san
original_name: あらぶるおっぱいさん
source:
The rambunctious tale of a busty young girl and a flat-chested goddess. Satisfy with H play, undo the curse of the seven Breast Gods!

There once were seven Breast Gods, each with ample bosoms except for miserable petite Hinpaiten.

One day a busty young girl named Kotori visited their shrine. Kotori was burdened by her large breasts and wished for a smaller pair. Hinpaiten, unhappy with her own smallness, was taken aback. When the other goddesses saw how Hinpaiten treated their guest they cursed her, binding the busty girl and the goddess together. The only way to satisfy break the curse was to satisfy the Breast Gods.

So begins the tale of a girl and a goddess, the ties that bind, and the breasts that bounce---

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE144838.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
巨乳少女与平胸女神的喧闹故事。满足H玩法，解除七乳神的诅咒！

曾经有七位胸神，除了可怜的娇小欣派腾之外，每一位都拥有丰满的胸部。

有一天，一位名叫小鸟的巨乳少女参拜了他们的神社。小鸟因为自己的大胸而感到负担，希望拥有一个小一点的乳房。Hinpaiten对自己的渺小感到不满，她大吃一惊。当其他女神看到Hinpaiten对待客人的方式时，他们诅咒了她，将丰满的女孩和女神绑在一起。满足打破诅咒的唯一方法就是满足胸神。

少女与女神、束缚的领带、弹跳的乳房的故事就这样开始了——
